observations: Photo 0 shows a long, rectangular I-beam lying on wooden planks in an outdoor yard. The beam is heavily rusted and shows signs of wear and dirt. The beam is positioned vertically, with people standing around it.

Photo 1 shows a stack of circular metal pipes, mostly galvanized or painted, with visible rust and corrosion on the ends. Some pipes have red or orange rings near the ends, possibly indicating a coating or repair.
Photo 2 shows a large stack of H-beam or channel steel beams, also heavily rusted and weathered. The beams are stacked outdoors against a brick wall, with some greenery visible at the base.
All photos carry a watermark: 'SALYEK STEEL LIMITED POSTED ON JIJI'.
The seller's text mentions 'scrap metals with good value' and 'Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.'
No brand or model markings are visible on any of the items in the photos.

claims.claim: I buy various scrap metals with good value
claims.evidence: The seller's statement is a general business claim; no proof of value or market conditions is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The metal may be low-grade scrap with low value or poor quality, affecting the buyer's use case.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the metal's cross-section or a label indicating grade, carbon content, or standard (e.g., ASTM A500, EN 10025).
risks.if_unproven: priced as low-grade scrap, which is typically worth less than high-grade steel.

risks.risk: The rust and corrosion may be extensive, indicating the metal has been exposed to air or moisture for a long time, reducing its structural integrity.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the rusted surface, especially on the ends and joints, to assess depth and extent.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily corroded scrap, which is typically worth less than clean or mild rust.

risks.risk: The metal may be of unknown origin or not certified, which could affect its usability or safety.
risks.proof: A label or stamp showing origin, certification, or standard of the scrap metal.
risks.if_unproven: priced as uncertified scrap, which is typically worth less than certified scrap.

proof_requests: Close-up of the metal's cross-section or any label indicating grade or standard.
Close-up of the rusted surface, especially on the ends and joints.
Any label or stamp showing origin or certification of the scrap metal.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
